about: The dw layer table (dw wave 1 Task 9): one row per asset in firmware/apps/dw/assets/. tools/dw_export.mjs captures the rows from the designers' mockups (read in place from $DW_DESIGN) and dw_generic.js; tools/dw_pack.py packs them. out: bin (a tagged canvas, found by its creating function fn while face is driven), strip (a tagged canvas unwrapped to ORS1: r0, r1, n_theta; in cf A8, its alpha alone as an A8 bin n_theta x n_r, Task 15), atlas (drawn by dw_export.js from font, size, weight, color, glow and glyphs, cited in src), generic (drawn by dw_generic.js's fn), thumb (face's settled frame, 68 px in the circle; swap draws a generic drawing in place of a tagged canvas), crop (rects of face's settled frames at their own local times, side by side; check names a geometry entry they must match), radial (a radial gradient from r0, r1, a0, a1, alpha only), layers (face's tagged canvases fn composed over black in order, each but its exclude rect), drawn (dw_export.js's own drawing DRAWN[fn] of a cited piece the mockup draws straight onto its frame). A bin row's rect takes one rect of its canvas, origin its place on the screen. An atlas row may set a gradient (stops [dy from the baseline, colour]). An atlas row may wrap its cells at maxw px and set its own pad. gen (wave 2 Task 13): the output of the row's generator gen (tools/dw_vortex.py, run by tools/dw_assets.sh after the export): an RGB565 bin from its PNG, or cf DAT, a table packed as it is (file <asset>.dat). Rows with crc32 are committed bytes (packed elsewhere, checked by pixel CRC-32). Names are dw_ + at most 12 characters.
